# invites.blog

> Premium animated invitation platform. Inviters build personalized, role-aware digital invitations
> from a template gallery with no account required; invitees open a per-guest link and RSVP with
> zero login.

## Template authoring

- [Template guide](/template-guide.md): the full reference for authoring an invites.blog template —
  the `data-var`/`data-href`/`data-src` tag vocabulary the builder reads, role-based content blocks,
  theming hooks, and the manifest format. Read this before writing or reviewing a template. Also
  rendered as an in-app page at [/template-guide](/template-guide) for human readers.

## Guest lists

- [Guest list guide](/guide): how to format a guest list for upload (columns, required fields,
  common mistakes), with a [downloadable blank .xlsx template](/guest-list-template.xlsx).
